title: Deep-Generative-models
summary: A single-file Python script (ctgan.py) that vendors the full CTGANSynthesizer implementation—including DataSampler, DataTransformer, Discriminator, and Residual modules—for training deep generative models on tabular data. The CTGAN package's source code is copied in-tree and its Discriminator/Residual/CTGANSynthesizer classes appear to be used directly.
evidence: ctgan.py:576-625 contains vendored ctgan.data_sampler, ctgan.data_transformer, ctgan.synthesizers.base imports and Discriminator/Residual class definitions copied from the ctgan package
needs: Unclear whether the vendored CTGAN code is ever invoked/trained in this repo beyond being copied in-tree; no training call site found in evidence.
